'''Hobgoblins''' are monsters found in [[Daemonheim]], on the [[Abandoned floors]]. These monsters use spears to attack, and have a chance of dropping them. At higher levels, these monsters are very dangerous, and can easily hit over 350.

==Drops==
===100%===
{{DropsTableHead}}
{{DropsLine|name=Bones (Dungeoneering)|quantity=1|rarity=Always|gemw=no}} 
{{DropsTableBottom}}

===Monster-specific===
These monsters can drop various spears when killed. The tier of the spear dropped depends on the level of the hobgoblin. For example, promethium spears are only dropped by level 141 hobgoblins.
